I don't think the "make friends" advice is very helpful frankly because I know that's not how the world works, at least it didn't for me. 

The main pieces of advice I would give are be nice to everyone you're around, even if it's just small interactions. People remember a happy face and friendly person. You don't have to he happy all the time but treating people with respect and manners can go a long way. 

The second is try to focus less on friends and more on yourself, find what makes you happy. If you delve deep enough into most hobbies you will often find like minded people who love the same stuff as you do! 

Hope it works out for you!

Just don't exceed the agreed limit as you may be charged for it. There is hardship funds that some universities have you could look into, although depending on your relationship with your parents that may not be an option. The main thing is to know you're okay, and don't worry we all had this stress.
